messages.sidebar.tagline: Built to help you recover space.
messages.welcome.subtitle: DiskSnoop scans your drives and finds heavy folders, caches, forgotten files, and app leftovers.
messages.welcome.safeBadge: Nothing is deleted automatically — you review everything first
messages.welcome.largeFoldersText: Ranking of the folders using the most space, with subfolder details.
messages.welcome.cleanupText: node_modules, build caches, old installers, forgotten downloads, and logs.
messages.welcome.quarantineText: Move items to quarantine before deleting. Restore with one click when needed.
messages.disks.title: Choose a drive
messages.scan.title: Scanning {drive}
messages.overview.duplicatesNeedManual: {size} appear as possible duplicates and need manual confirmation.
messages.overview.reviewBeforeDelete: Review candidates and quarantine before any permanent deletion.
messages.updates.title: Updates
messages.updates.subtitle: Manage DiskSnoop versions, release notes, and updates.
messages.updates.availableText: A newer version is available. Automatic download can prepare the update without restarting the app.
messages.updates.downloadedText: The file was downloaded. Because this is the portable channel, open the installer/file manually.
messages.updates.restartText: The installer downloaded the update. DiskSnoop only restarts when you confirm.
messages.updates.defaultText: The app can check for new versions without interrupting your work.
messages.updates.assistedText: On the portable build, DiskSnoop checks and downloads the new version, but it does not replace the running executable. Use the downloaded file or the releases page to update manually.
messages.updates.autoText: On the installed channel, DiskSnoop downloads the update automatically and only restarts to apply it after your confirmation.
messages.updates.restartUnavailablePortable: Automatic restart is unavailable in portable
messages.updates.appInfoText: Useful details for support and local maintenance.
messages.updates.diagnosticsText: Use this block to confirm the published release matches the app type currently running.
messages.updates.expectedInstalled: Setup .exe, .blockmap, and latest.yml in the GitHub Release
messages.updates.expectedAssisted: Windows artifact published in GitHub Releases
messages.updates.manualNote: The installed app is in assisted mode because manual update preference is enabled. Disable this option in Preferences to use the automatic installer.
messages.updates.betaNote: The Beta channel is enabled in preferences. Disable this option to search only stable releases.
messages.updates.localChangelog: Showing local notes for the installed version. When a published release includes a changelog, it appears here automatically.
messages.updates.noChangelog: No changelog is available yet. If a release is published, you can still open the releases page to review it manually.
messages.updates.prefManual: Use manual update even in the installer
messages.updates.prefAutoDownload: Download updates automatically in the installer
messages.updates.prefAutoDownloadHelp: DiskSnoop still asks for confirmation before restarting.
messages.updates.ignored: Ignored version: {version}. A manual check searches again and shows future versions.
